item.title: ACCC Issues Recall of Children's Toys Over Presence of Asbestos
item.description: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission has issued a recall of two children's toys after it was discovered they had asbestos.

item.title: DFAT Confirms Afghan Embassy in Canberra Will Close in June 2026
item.description: The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade has confirmed that the Afghan embassy located in Canberra will close on June 30, 2026.

item.title: Millions of Android AI Apps Hide a Dangerous Secret—and Researchers Just Exposed It
item.description: A massive audit of Android AI apps reveals widespread hardcoded secrets, exposed cloud data, and live payment risks, raising serious questions about Play Store security.

item.title: TasWater's Proposed 8.8 Per Cent Price Hike Slashed by Regulator
item.description: Economic Regulator Joe Dimasi only approved a 4.3 per cent increase for water and sewerage services for Tasmania households.

item.title: Proven Through Cycles: How Phillips & Cohen Assoc's 27-Year History Redefines Enterprise Stability
item.description: A recovery-rate promise is easy to make. The harder promise is continuity, the ability to keep your operation stable when market pressure rises, when scrutiny increases, and when you need records and controls to hold up. Phillips & Cohen Associates, Ltd. (PCA) has built its reputation on that harder promise.

item.title: The Trade Titan of the South: Analyzing Australia's Top 10 Export Destinations in 2026
item.description: For decades, the Australian economy has been described as "riding on the sheep's back" or "digging its way to prosperity."

item.title: Nestlé Australia Confirms Removal of Allen's Black Cats from Supermarket Shelves
item.description: Nestlé Australia has confirmed that Allen's Black Cats have been removed from supermarket shelves in the country.

item.title: Elon Musk Says SpaceX-xAI Merger Will Form 'Most Ambitious' Engine With AI
item.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX has acquired xAI, aiming to move AI data centers into orbit, reshape global computing, and fund his long-term vision for space expansion.

item.title: The Bounce Matters: Inside the Rise of Professional-Grade Hoops for Everyday Players
item.description: A basketball is more than a ball: it is ambition in motion, spinning, snapping off hardwood, arching through a hoop with purpose. Yet for decades, backyard basketball for many players around the world meant makeshift goals: a hoop scavenged from a garage sale, a rim mounted on a garage door, or an imported set that promised play but delivered disappointment.

item.title: RBA Lifts Interest Rates by 0.25 Percentage Points, Says Inflation Picked Up in Second Half of 2025
item.description: The Reserve Bank has lifted the interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, and the new cash rate is now at 3.85 per cent.
